Figure 4 presents two paired bar graphs, each illustrating the proportion of various categories within a dataset labeled as "各活体中文化的词语” (translated as "Words of Enculturation in Living Subjects"). The left graph of each pair exhibits a horizontal axis displaying categories labeled as “男幼” (male infant), “女幼”（female infant), “男童”（male child), “女童”（female child), “男少”（male adolescent), and “女少”（female adolescent），presented in that order. The vertical axis is linear, labeled "频次" (frequency), with values ranging from 0 to 7000. Numerical tick marks are visible at intervals of 1000. The heights of the bars representing the various categories diverge considerably: the highest bar, for “男少”, reaches an approximate height of 6600, while the shortest bar, for "女幼", measures approximately 300. The right graph of each pair is arranged differently. The horizontal axis displays categories labeled as “轻微” (minor), “中度”（moderate), and “严重”（severe），presented in that order.  The vertical axis is linear, with values ranging from 0 to 6000, and showing tick marks at intervals of 1000. The bars representing the conditions are visually clustered; “中度” reaches an approximate height of 5400, “轻微” approximately 5000, and "严重" approximately 300. In both graphs, each bar's color alternates between shades of orange, blue, and green, without explicit legend. There is no apparent sorting mechanism applied to the categories along the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or annotations.
